newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end firmer amid slow sales of new straights.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end firmer amid slow sales of new straights.

text.p: * Key September 10-year JGBs ended firmer as dealers with short positions for hedging purposes covered them amid slow sales of new corporate bonds. Weaker Tokyo stocks supportive.
* Chugoku Electric and Tokyo Electric launched 20-year bonds with coupons at 3.225 percent, but failed to attract investors.
